content.text: Netflix has officially renewed Tyler Perry’s Beauty in Black for a third and final season! After the shocking events of Season 2 Part 1, Kimmie is fully stepping into her role as the new HBIC of the Bellarie family empire. Fans are gearing up for jaw-dropping twists, shocking betrayals, and unexpected alliances in Season 2 Part 2, premiering March 19, 2026. Will Mallory finally challenge Kimmie? How will the Bellarie family survive the chaos? Watch now for the latest updates and first-look images. Stay tuned for all the updates on Kimmie’s rise to power and the Bellarie family drama!
